title: Scenario runner: the seed drops every owner-scoped row (handle left in the owner field; non-persona handles have no user), and the author loop never runs verify
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ① defect with a measured reproduction. Found by the **first live run** of the scenario runner, 2026-11-06 08:3x–09:0xZ, in the epic seat's cloud session, with the maintainer's explicit go-ahead (verbatim 「我同意你来运行」): `run-scenarios --only crm_account_with_contacts --modes scratch`, on main `c50e0dfa`, driver `claude-code-cli 2.1.318 · login: oauth_token · API-billed: no`. Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」. Epic: objectstack-ai/cloud#3600.

Scorecard of that run:

| Half | scratch |
|:--|:--|
| Build | 20/20 ⚠ degraded (failed: verify) |
| Run-问数 | 1/9 |
| Run-operations | 0/5 |
| Iterate · Build | 27/27 ⚠ degraded |
| Iterate · Run-问数 | 2/9 |
| Iterate · Run-operations | 0/5 |

**The Run halves measured the runner, not the app.** The defects below explain them.

## Defect 1 (blocker): the seed loses every owner-scoped row

The run record shows `seed: inserted 1`; 7 rows refused:
- `democrm_account` ac1, ac3: `VALIDATION_FAILED · Account Owner: no sys_user record has id "u_sam"`; ac2: `… "u_tia"`;
- every contact on those accounts: `Account: no democrm_account record has id "ac1"` (and so on), as a cascade.

Cause (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts:314-325`): for a field named in a persona's `scope` (`account.owner`), the runner sets `body.owner_id = <persona user id>` but leaves the field's own value as the literal handle (`owner: "u_sam"`). A faithful build models `owner` as a user lookup (this build: `type: user`, `reference: sys_user`), which rejects the handle. A handle that belongs to no persona (`u_tia`) has no user at all.

With only ct4 loaded, 8 of 9 questions had nothing to count (`account_count` as sdr answered "0 accounts"), and every write found no target, so no write was attempted.

**Ask:**
1. Replace a scope field's handle with that persona's user id in the row itself, as well as `owner_id`.
2. Every handle a seed row names in an owner-scoped field must resolve to a user. Provision a non-login user for each handle no persona holds (`u_tia`), or state another contract in the build prompt. The prompt's "Row ownership" line (`prompts.ts` `dataContract`) must match what the runner does.
3. A refused seed row makes the Run half **not measured**, not a fail. Show `⚠ seed: N refused` on the scorecard and mark questions and operations that depend on a refused row as not measured.

## Defect 2: the author loop never runs `verify`

`BUILD_PREAMBLE` and `iteratePrompt` (`prompts.ts:114-130`) tell the agent to run `validate` and `build` only. The runner then runs `verify --reference-shapes`, which failed on this build. An AI-authored hook used a wrong filter shape (`findOne('democrm_account')` with an object at `where.id`, refused loudly as `INVALID_FILTER`), and a user field the hook overwrites admitted 12 of 12 wrong-shape writes as null. The agent never saw either.

**Ask:** include the same `verify` invocation the runner scores with in the author and iterate loops, so a degraded build means the agent could not fix it, not that it was never told.

## Verification

Re-run `run-scenarios --only crm_account_with_contacts --modes scratch` after the fix. The scorecard must show the seed fully loaded (8/8) before the Run halves can be read. The recording of the first run is held by the epic seat, and its replay (`--driver recorded:`) reproduces Defect 1 without a model.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`.
